entities.summary: George Boahen Oduro is a Ghanaian politician and member of the Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the New Edubease Constituency in the Ashanti Region on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party. He was the Deputy Minister for Food and Agriculture.
